headline: Requested solicitor opinions on housing trust funds and Independence Park, and extended Cabot House Porticos MOU.
summary: The committee continued review of CPA Funding Round 13 applications, including Garden City Towers Fire Protection, Beverly Affordable Housing Trust, Gillis Park Basketball Court, Central Cemetery Tomb House, Central Cemetery Fence and Gates, and The Garden School roof project, raising questions for applicants on several. It voted to seek City Solicitor guidance on the Affordable Housing Trust funding and on recouping funds from the Independence Park project, extended the Cabot House Porticos MOU deadline, and discussed project updates and closeouts including the Girdler House Generator, Cabot Theater, and Balch Playground.
decisions: Motion that the Chair request an opinion from the City Solicitor regarding the Beverly Affordable Housing Trust project types related to eligibility for CPA funds, as well as terms of affordability. Motion carries (6-0).
Motion to extend the R12-2 MOU (Cabot House Porticos) to September 30, 2026. Motion carries (6-0).

Motion to request guidance from the City Solicitor regarding if it would be appropriate to recoup some of the funding from the Independence Park project, and to forward the letter dated December 18, 2025, and the application and final report. Motion carries (6-0).
